records.name: Prolactinoma
records.mechanism: D2-responsive lactotroph PitNET; hyperprolactinemia suppresses GnRH
records.management: cabergoline; surgery selected cases

records.name: Acromegaly from growth-hormone-secreting PitNET
records.mechanism: excess GH stimulates IGF-1 and chronic tissue overgrowth
records.management: transsphenoidal resection; somatostatin analogs, pegvisomant or cabergoline in selected cases

records.name: Cushing disease
records.mechanism: ACTH-producing pituitary lesion drives bilateral cortisol excess
records.management: pituitary surgery; approved medical control when surgery unsuccessful or not feasible

records.name: Pituitary apoplexy
records.mechanism: hemorrhage/infarction within pituitary tumour causes acute neuroendocrine crisis
records.management: urgent glucocorticoids and neurosurgical/endocrine evaluation

records.name: Sheehan syndrome
records.mechanism: postpartum hemorrhagic shock causes ischemic anterior pituitary injury
records.management: replace cortisol before levothyroxine where both deficient

records.name: Arginine vasopressin deficiency
records.mechanism: inadequate AVP secretion prevents urinary concentrating response
records.management: desmopressin and supervised fluid/sodium management

records.name: Syndrome of inappropriate antidiuresis
records.mechanism: nonosmotic AVP effect causes impaired free-water excretion
records.management: treat cause; fluid restriction or selected targeted therapy; hypertonic saline if severe symptomatic

records.name: Subacute granulomatous thyroiditis
records.mechanism: painful destructive folliculitis releases stored thyroid hormone
records.management: NSAIDs; short steroid course if severe; temporary beta blockade as needed

records.name: Toxic multinodular goiter
records.mechanism: autonomous follicular nodules make hormone despite TSH suppression
records.management: antithyroid stabilization, radioiodine or surgery as appropriate

records.name: Thyroid storm
records.mechanism: decompensated severe thyrotoxicosis causes systemic hyperadrenergic multiorgan injury
records.management: ICU support; thionamide, iodine after thionamide, beta blockade if safe, steroids

records.name: Myxedema coma
records.mechanism: severe thyroid-hormone deprivation causes hypoventilation, hypothermia and organ dysfunction
records.management: ICU; IV thyroid hormone and stress glucocorticoids until adrenal failure excluded

records.name: Anaplastic thyroid carcinoma
records.mechanism: high-grade rapidly invasive thyroid epithelial malignancy, often MAPK-driven
records.management: airway/oncology evaluation; molecular testing; BRAF/MEK targeting when BRAF V600E-positive

records.name: Primary aldosteronism
records.mechanism: renin-independent aldosterone activates MR causing volume expansion and K loss
records.management: screen with aldosterone/renin; adrenalectomy unilateral or MR blockade bilateral

records.name: Primary adrenal insufficiency
records.mechanism: adrenal destruction or dysfunction causes cortisol deficiency with variable aldosterone loss
records.management: physiologic hydrocortisone and mineralocorticoid where indicated

records.name: Adrenal crisis
records.mechanism: critical cortisol lack causes vasoplegia, shock, electrolyte/glucose disturbances
records.management: immediate parenteral hydrocortisone, isotonic fluids and cause treatment

records.name: 21-hydroxylase deficiency CAH
records.mechanism: CYP21A2 defect impairs cortisol ± aldosterone synthesis and raises androgen precursors
records.management: specialist steroid/mineralocorticoid replacement and stress dosing

records.name: Glucocorticoid-induced adrenal insufficiency
records.mechanism: exogenous glucocorticoids suppress CRH-ACTH axis and adrenal cortisol production
records.management: individualized taper, stress dosing and assessment of HPA recovery

records.name: Hypoparathyroidism
records.mechanism: inadequate PTH lowers renal Ca reclamation and active vitamin D synthesis
records.management: calcium, active vitamin D, magnesium as needed; PTH therapy selected cases

records.name: Pseudohypoparathyroidism
records.mechanism: GNAS or other signaling defects cause renal end-organ PTH resistance
records.management: treat hypocalcemia with active vitamin D/calcium; monitor PTH and phosphorus

records.name: Diabetic ketoacidosis
records.mechanism: insulin deficiency drives lipolysis, hepatic ketogenesis and high-anion-gap acidosis
records.management: fluid, potassium evaluation/replacement, IV insulin with substrate monitoring

records.name: Hyperosmolar hyperglycemic state
records.mechanism: severe hyperglycemia and water depletion lead to hyperosmolality, generally little ketosis
records.management: fluid resuscitation, potassium and cautious insulin guided by osmolality

records.name: Multiple endocrine neoplasia type 1
records.mechanism: MEN1 loss of menin predisposes parathyroid, pituitary and enteropancreatic tumours
records.management: gene-directed surveillance and organ-specific endocrine tumour management

records.name: Multiple endocrine neoplasia type 2
records.mechanism: germline RET gain of function predisposes MTC ± pheochromocytoma
records.management: variant-guided prophylactic thyroidectomy; treat pheochromocytoma first

records.name: Noninvasive follicular thyroid neoplasm with papillary-like nuclear features
records.mechanism: encapsulated follicular lesion with PTC nuclear features but no invasion, papillae or high-grade features
records.management: diagnostic excision, often lobectomy, without automatic radioiodine
